dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the central region towards both the anterior and posterior frame boundaries.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a uniform slate grey skin tone across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient observed between subtle tonal shifts with no sharp pigment transitions visible.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, light-colored linear marks oriented diagonally across the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of healed linear marks/rake marks visible as low-contrast disruptions on the dorsal epidermis.
